notes.title: Welcome to Monster Summer Camp!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Monster Summer Camp![/h1]

[previewyoutube=Tp0Y9Ewx9Q0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The Monsters are headed to camp and you’re invited to bring your whole crew along for some Summer fun![/h2]

[h2]We’re calling upon the Community to help us have the best Summer EVER by inviting your friends and family to join My Singing Monsters! Every new Camper helps stoke the fire, unlocking even more rewards for the entire My Singing Monsters Community![/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/6b57e8ab0e8e1eb796c637220822159e9dc0ec79.png[/img]


[h2]How It Works[/h2]

[h3]Share your Referral Code[/h3]

Recruit your crew to start playing My Singing Monsters! Every time your referral code is used by a new player installing and playing the game, you AND your friends will receive in-game rewards! But that’s not all! Each new player that joins My Singing Monsters helps the community progress toward Camp Prizes, including costumes, currency, and MORE! As you help more players join My Singing Monsters, all My Singing Monsters players will receive rewards in their in-game mailbox. The more friends that join the campfire, the bigger the fire gets! 

[h3]Track Progress at the Campfire![/h3]

As new recruits join us at Monster Summer Camp, the campfire will get bigger and better! The more rewards that are unlocked, the larger the fire grows, rewarding the ENTIRE My Singing Monsters Community with in-game prizes! Each reward unlocked will add an additional element to the campfire scene, so you’ll want to make sure you’re watching the campfire glow brighter as our Monster Camp spirit heats up! 

[h3]Community Campfire Rewards[/h3]

Every new Camper who joins the game will help unlock lots of awesome in-game prizes! Here’s what you can expect:

100,000 coins
Mystery Box
50,000 Treats
Rare Furcorn with its “What’s The Ti” costume
25 Diamonds
100,000 Treats
250,000 coins
Mystery Box
Final Reward: Tawkerr with its exclusive Stark Raving Costume! + Thumpies “BeehAw!” Costume

[i]Important notes: Monster Summer Camp rewards will be available to claim for a limited time, and are delivered to players via the in-game Mailbox. Make sure to check your Mailbox regularly to claim your rewards before they're gone![/i]


[h2]Join In On The Fun![/h2]

[h3]Find your Referral Code in game! [/h3]

Your Referral Code is simply your BBB ID/Friend Code!

[h3]Share your Referral Code with Friends and Family![/h3]

New Recruits can submit your referral code during the tutorial OR in the “Options” menu! You will receive bonus rewards for each user that uses your Referral Code!

[h3]Watch the Community Campfire grow![/h3]

We will share Community Progress with in-game announcements, social media posts, and regular Discord Updates! Each unlocked Campfire prize level will reward the ENTIRE Community, so make sure you are checking the Campfire regularly!


[b]Camp opens on Wednesday, July 16, 2025 at 3 PM ET and runs through to Wednesday, August 13, 2025 at 3 PM ET.[/b]


[h3]Let’s grow our camp, light the Campfire, and make some Monster Summer Camp memories together![/h3]

For full contest details, please visit our website: https://bigbl.be/camp

[h2]How to Enter[/h2]

[b]1. Draw a Costume for the Monster of your choice![/b]

You can use traditional art forms like markers, crayons, paint, etc. or you can use digital art tools!

[i]Please note: You cannot use AI to generate and create artwork for your Costume. Using AI to create your costume will result in automatic disqualification. [/i]


[b]2. Post an image of the Costume you have designed and share it on the Social Media Platform of your choice using #MySingingMonsters #CreatorCostumeContest[/b]

You can upload your part to TikTok, Bluesky, Twitter (X), Instagram, or YouTube! Just make sure to include the hashtag in your post! 


[b]3. Submit the LINK to your submission in the #Creator-Costume-Contest Channel in the Official My Singing Monsters Discord.[/b]

[u]We will only be selecting entries that have been submitted through Discord, so make sure to join! You can join the Discord here: https://discord.gg/GZFTqR4kav [/u]

[i]Please Note: Contestants under the age of 13 must have their parents submit their entry on their behalf using their own Discord Account.[/i]

We will select THREE grand prize winners whose Costumes will be added into My Singing Monsters at a later date! Grand prize winners will also receive their Costume in-game when the Costume is released, as well as in-game rewards!

We will also select 10 runner-ups who will receive in-game rewards!

The winners will be announced in July on all of our social media platforms, so keep your eyes peeled!

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/mysingingmonsters/

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Cm1gf0DIYnw;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]What’s New in Version 4.3.0[/h2]

[h3]NEW Monster World Map![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/da8f6f0f33c3de5942b66ec9042ec668dcdad6b4.png[/img]

Finally - the moment you’ve ALL been waiting for…the NEW MAP has finally arrived in the Monster World! The Spurrits were able to successfully survey the toroidal Monster World and translate it into the easily-digestible Map we now see today! 

With the new Map update brings a lot of quality of life and navigation improvements. You can now easily swipe around the Map, venturing between the Islands of the Monster World. You’ll discover all the Islands of the Monster World, including the Dreamspace, Higher Plane, the tunnels beneath the Monster World, below the surface of the Living Ocean - all the way to the Monstriana Trench! You can now see exactly where each Island exists in relation to one another all in one place! 

You’ll also notice a new and improved sidebar that allows you to quickly scroll through the list of Islands! Each panel will display a tooltip indicating if you have Eggs ready to hatch or currency to be collected! Selecting an Island will zoom the Map in directly to that Island, displaying even more useful information about that Island, including how many Common, Rare, or Epic Monsters you own on each Island, how many Costumes you have acquired, and if there is a Seasonal Event taking place! 

We hope you enjoy the brand new Map. Hop into the game right now to get a glimpse! 


[h3]NEW Monster: Epic Spurrit[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/ea79ed9b109c58ba63c88ccbcfcc185dd6cf32be.png[/img]

Huzzah! Epic Spurrit looks like it’s been spending a lot of time at the gym, perfecting its physique to be in peak condition for its arrival to the Monster World! The idealization of Epic Spurrit's toned and chiseled exterior is matched by its practically perfect demeanor. This Epic Monster can be described as cool, calm, and collected, and seems to always have the best advice! The only drawback? Epic Spurrit can sometimes get carried away with bragging about its muscular structure. But can we blame it? It did work so hard, after all…


[h3]NEW Monster: Mimic[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/c8475a955ff19e17be21656ec7a89ee4b3c7eaba.png[/img]

Ah-HA! We knew this Air Top Boss had been laying low in the Monster World since the Dawn of Fire era, masquerading around as its fellow Monsters! But at long last, the Mimic has finally revealed itself! Finding its home on Fire Oasis, the Mimic seems to be trying to pass itself off as a…Relic-seeking Fire Monster?! It seems as though this Master of Mischief has figured out a way to create a mysterious aura around itself that allows it to bend the light around it! But make no mistake… you’ll definitely recognize that voice.  

[h3]
NEW Monster: Epic Phangler[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/e8a215759e5a803a323243817aad66b219ea2e0e.png[/img]

Lurking deep down near the bottom of the Living Ocean, this contradictory Epic Monster was discovered, bearing multiple ominous looking eyes, fluorescent lighting, and a striking violet constitution! Even though Epic Phangler looks like a benthic beast, it actually enjoys soaking up the rats closer to the water's surface, much like its Rare cousin! One may think that this abundantly-eyed Monster would have impeccable eyesight, however these Epic Monsters are only able to see shades of violet (probably to help them find one another).


[h3]Wubbox on Fire Oasis[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/1c3b66a56256e80c8cbb4269b9d877eab8811b2e.png[/img]

It’s time to Wub-Up-The-Volume! The notorious Supernatural Monster has finally made its way to Fire Oasis! Head over to the Island RIGHT NOW and hear the Wub-tastic addition this toe-tapping, dub-stepping Monster adds to the song! 



[h3]Perplexplore Island Skin[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/257ec9c02aab21f65bbfeba7adcb9c1d228f7f71.png[/img]

Perplexplore has begun on Fire Oasis! You can sample the Monster World Hub of Discovery for a limited time, or purchase the Island Skin to enjoy all year round! 



[h3]NEW Perplexplore Costumes[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/a41b45944d060565a5469edb1d613832a7f93b21.png[/img]

With another Seasonal Update comes new Seasonal Costumes! You won’t want to miss these exploratory-themed Costumes for some of the most-loved Monsters in the game! Available now, for a limited time!



NEW Perplexplore Decorations

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/8fe14f3dcb3d191cf1d4d1852921e347911a0590.png[/img]

This year, the Perplexplore Island Skin on Fire Oasis really comes to life when you decorate it with the all-new animated Perplexplore Decorations! [h2]What’s New in Version 4.1.2[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/36c5abc5bd65098d6b3e7d0e689d84776cfc32ca.png[/img]

[h3]NEW Refined Synthesizer[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/8010800737c3b4d8322f64823ee0340dba2209b5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/6c8328daa3e7dde35ec85c3b53392e28735110c8.png[/img][/url]

The Refined Synthesizer upgrade has made its debut! This is to accommodate for the instability present in more advanced Triple combinations (and can even manage unstable Quad-Element configuration!). This process is only possible by using an already-coalesced form to build upon…not to mention the Meebs and Shards! However, in the name of science, progress cannot be stopped and innovation never curtailed! So, onward we go! You’ll need it for… 


[h2]Ethereal Workshop Wave 2![/h2]

[h3]NEW Monster: Flasque[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/986556797c98e2509ed2a9c966c3f35ef69206ce.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/c74bb78bbe3318692b5f5bfe55b2a28c030883ec.png[/img][/url]

This Monster (which looks much like a science experiment!) consists of little more than beakers and chalices, but don’t let that fool you! The Flasque is loud and proud, clinking and clanking its instruments together to add a robust sound to the Island’s song. The green lifeblood seen throughout its body ensures that no matter how hard this methodical Monster clangs its glass vessels, they will never break!

[h3]NEW Monster: Nitebear[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/6a0caec27b83a61d29001cd1edf2a01487684c9c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/22200c703eee3c6158aae49046cf96f866e88866.png[/img][/url]

It is not fully understood exactly what powers the Nitebear, but some have guessed that it may be run by quirky animatronics (based on the cables sticking out of its head). This disconsolate-looking Monster expresses itself using a combination of groans and moans, leading some to believe this Monster is exhibiting sentiments of sadness. Because it demonstrates a melancholic disposition, this Monster is nervous about socializing, fearing it may be “killing the mood.” Its friends are always happy to have it around though, and love it when Nitebear comes out of its self-inflicted isolation and join in on the song!

[h3]NEW Monster: Whaill[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/20aff4430c228f4e813464d6393f33d921f57b36.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/23db950115a5bf0f9879ae479cc7182c83c68caa.png[/img][/url]

You’re bound to have a Whaill-ing good time with this new Ethereal Workshop Monster! Blessed with the ululations that gargle from its many mouths, the Whaill can create sound waves that are so intense that they actually tear apart the fabric of space and time! Legends say they can even expose reality to the Rift, closing the gap between worlds… 

[h3]NEW Monster: Epic Bellowfish[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/2dca2eb9c11a86b42d92f902b5581d127dff805c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/09bb62491a75ebd21f56bfba33f796fa7dd6d994.png[/img][/url]

Although its crystal is cracked like its Rare cousin, Epic Bellowfish couldn’t be more different! Outfitted with a suit made of rubber and extending past its torso to include its arms and legs as well, this Epic Ethereal is ready to defend against foreign contaminants and be shielded at all times! Although it’s a well-known secret that this Epic Monster may have a sensitivity to acquaslime, its Monster friends keep it to themselves to safeguard its dignity. Their motto? S’all good, Mon. 

[h3]NEW Monster: Rare Monculus[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/aae30e35550903e40900f02532791c8193e086e3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/fed72d6058e2084b62068eba09a08d9c85fb7af4.png[/img][/url]

The Rare Monculus has an interesting history, dating back to the era when the Colossals were using the pocket dimension as the site for their world-building experiments. In what can now be considered a humorous oversight, the Bubblerite jars and vases they used to store Monculus’ building blocks were equally susceptible to the spark of life - and became a Monster of their very own!

[h3]NEW Monster: Rare Scargo[/h3]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/24b73c1f092be71c509959374ee44cf9bbe8dafa.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/437a319d4c93043fa8b83cfd9a0466e8153c2eb5.png[/img][/url]


Rare Scargo is known to many in the Monster World as an expert gift-giver, so it makes sense that it would be discovered during this time of year. It’s always creating imaginative toys and trinkets for its fellow Wublins, catering to each of their individual likes and needs. It has even attempted to create a giant musical contraption, known as the “electro-Mon-cardio-snooks,” which must be operated by several Monsters at once. The only problem is the excessive noise, as this goofy gadget can’t possibly compete with the decibels attainable by only the Rare Scargo…

[previewyoutube=Ac9apEJp7jM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What’s New in Version 4.1.1[/h2]

[h3]NEW Fire Expansion[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/60319cd87a9c14b76154cb725dc7c10afaae75c6.png[/img]

For the first time ever, Monsters that were previously exclusive to Amber Island have made their way to the Fire and Magical Islands! These Monsters are exclusively available in the Market for Relics, with their accompanying Rares appearing as StarShop exclusives. Pro tip: If you've been keeping up with Amber Island, that Relic generation investment is paying off! The Monster-Handlers are really fired-up for these new discoveries, but urge you to act quickly: these Fire Monsters will only be available for the duration of Feast-Ember. Get that fire started quickly!

[h3]NEW Monster: Rare Spurrit[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/07e0809b43905f96cc19d6063e87c65640160bef.png[/img]

We already knew that drinking water from the Living Ocean may cause some…undesirable effects…The Monster-Handlers have furthered their research into this strange anomaly only to discover that drinking Living Ocean water can also duplicate Spurrits! Well, sort of. Rare Spurrit seems to have emerged from this “cloning” conundrum, but is much more impulsive and distracted than its Common cousin. Fret not, this inquisitive Monster still has a passion for exploration and discovery, just with a bit more unbridled enthusiasm. 

[h3]NEW Monster: Rare Candelavra[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/81b159113a2a9fe5e17127f8552aa00a3e2c0574.png[/img]

It had long been rumored that a faction of Candelavras (also known as a “mint”) ventured to explore the depths of the underground tunnels during the Dawn of Fire era to shield themselves from the upheaval of the world around them, one day hoping to return to the surface they once called home. These rumors turned out to be true, however these ambitious Monsters were sadly unsuccessful in their venture. Over the course of their journey, these spelunking Candelavras began to exhibit some traits that would suit their new underground life and transformed into the Rare version we have recently discovered! 

[h3]NEW Monster: Rare Bona-Petite[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/315826a38c217f033f6723cac01a661c009c6eb7.png[/img]

We all know how important our personal time and space away from our families can truly be. This may not be possible for the Rare Bona-Petite though - this Monster duo is the very definition of “tight-knit!” This fluorescent Rare team may get on each other’s nerves once in a while, but they always know better than to take one another for granted. 

[h3]Gobbleygourd on the Fire Islands[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/1db10c43434569e28274341d40d1889871d6525a.png[/img]

The much-loved Feast-Ember Seasonal Monster, Gobbleygourd, has returned again for a gobblin’ good time time on Fire Haven and Fire Oasis! Prepared for a bountiful harvest and an abundant feast, none of the Monsters will be going hungry during this Feast-Ember Season! Don’t worry though, all of the Monsters in the Monster World are vegan, so no one will be trying to take a bite out of this bird!

[h3]Feast-Ember Seasonal Island Skin[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/48694d77b093ba39d0c4d30077f549ea66123ca8.png[/img]

With another Seasonal Event comes our final Seasonal Island Skin! There’s no better way to kick off your Feast-Ember than by basking in the plentiful banquet that Fire Haven has to offer, which now looks more juicy and bountiful than ever. You can unlock the Feast-Ember Fire Haven skin permanently so you can celebrate all the things you are thankful for all year round!

[h3]Feast-Ember Costumes, Decorations, and Obstacle-Decorations
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/75328a19fbc2b09a205842453fe6ab1157cc1251.png[/img]

You’ll be extra thankful for the festive and jovial Island decorations that celebrate a year-long harvest! While they enjoy their bounties, your Monsters will be fit for the party in their jubilant and joyous Feast-Ember Costumes, available for a limited time!

And that’s not all! Download Version 4.1.1 to experience it all yourself in one of our biggest updates of all time! 

[h3]In This Update[/h3]

NEW Fire Expansion
NEW Monster: Rare Spurrit
NEW Monster: Rare Candelavra
Gobbleygourd on Fire Haven
Feast-Ember Seasonal Island Skin
Feast-Ember Costumes, Decorations, and Obstacle-Decorations
…and sales and promotions all event long!

notes.title: Spooktacle 2023
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=zAP1MLnfZZg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]What’s New[/h1]
[h2]Punkleton, Rare Punkleton, and Epic Punkleton Return[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/04de5d10314f37a07643a468c2e7354f766226f3.png[/img]

It’s the Season of Spook, and what could be more Spook-tacular than the reemergence of the Punkleton trio! Talk about “squash” goals! Punkleton, Rare Punkleton, and Epic Punkleton will be available at varying times throughout the course of Spooktacle! 

[h2]NEW Monster: Rare Gheegur[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/0df0332a5c1c1fee24b49d71759b166db4ee6f31.png[/img]

There’s really no better time than Spooktacle for us to discover the mad-scientist-inspired Rare Gheegur! This Rare Wublin sure looks like it has a real knack for bringing kooky creations to life! You may have noticed this Rare version is lacking its Common cousin’s trademark glow! Legend says that’s so it can lurk around in the dark more easily, making some of its fellow Wublins apprehensive of it. But fret not! There’s nothing spooky about Rare Gheegur - in fact, it is a very funny and courteous fellow!

[h2]NEW Monster: Epic Thrumble[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/ca31731c62d417b75f1a3aa7e9fd58ca41b65af2.png[/img]

From deep within the waters of the Monstriana Trench, we have uncovered none other than Epic Thrumble! Although this subspecies has a much younger lineage than other Epic Monsters, Epic Thrumbles are still a fantastical faction! Rumor has it that their genetics may have been spliced with Glubber DNA, but it seems to have more in common with Anemonons or Jlelljiggles! Buy or breed it for a limited time on Bone Island… Thankfully, the October monthly Amber Set contains Thrumble’s Vessel, so you can begin attempting to evolve it on Amber Island, too!

[h2]Spooktacle Island Skin[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/9ed95615989715624943346705a2dde0ec9cdfe3.png[/img]

It certainly wouldn’t be Spooktacle if Plant Island wasn’t transformed into a frighteningly fabulous, Spookular scene! You can now purchase the Plant Island Spooktacle skin and celebrate Spooky Season all year round! 

[h2]Spooktacle Decorations and Seasonal Obstacle-Decorations[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/03aefefec192859b1e2179e613b91556730552ee.png[/img]

Looking to decorate your Island with some boo-tiful decor? You can really trick-or-treat yourself this Spooktacle season with this collection of fang-tastic Obstacle-Decorations and Animated Decorations! Your Monsters will be having a howlin’ good time with these eerie-sistable embellishments!

[h2]Spooktacle Costumes[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/7c7c0aa44d73e8327c7b529a9fc6f17891f89035.png[/img]

Make sure your Monsters are looking fa-boo-lous this Spooktacle Season! Choose from over 30 fang-favorite, gourd-eous, humerus Costumes! After all, if you’ve got it, haunt it!

[previewyoutube=_QZTGni5ZU8;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/c9649f67ff0f605cf07591f30ae02cf635b44054.png[/img]

[h2][b]What’s New in Version 4.1
NEW Island: Ethereal Workshop[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/6d936da2101cb55e2c2d3fce515e33dcb9fab284.png[/img]

We weren’t kidding when we said “It’s all in your head!” Welcome to the Ethereal Workshop, located inside Ethereal Island Colossal’s cranium! Zarroë has achieved what was previously thought to be impossible by bringing to life Triple-Element Ethereals (and beyond!) using the power of “Meebs” and curious new Structures we’ve never encountered before! Head to the Ethereal Workshop and help the Colossal reach its goal of creating a symphony of beautiful and mind-bending music!

[h2]NEW Monsters: Triple-Element Ethereals[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/881bdda6189a8f6610793d2eda5d35a972c5e845.png[/img]

It’s been a long time since Single and Double-Element Ethereals were discovered, and after such a long wait, we are very excited to introduce the first-ever Triple-Element Ethereals! You’ve already met Meebkin, our googly-eyed friend with a greater-than-average affinity for the Meeb critters you’ll get to know on Ethereal Workshop. This courteous caretaker houses Meebs inside of its baton-like instrument and rhythmically twirls it to help the Critters make their enchanting sounds. But Meebkin isn’t the only new Monster brought to fruition on Ethereal Workshop! Visit the new Island and discover four more Ethereal acquaintances!   

[h2]Double-Element Ethereals on the Colossingum[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/b8b16478d6777f049b0a60e580e92fec5f254521.png[/img]

Double-Element Ethereals have finally arrived on the Colossingum with a series of brand new quests, costumes, and trophies to be won! These new permanent quests and affluent attire will be arriving on a bi-weekly basis, starting on October 19th! We are also excited to announce that the Colossingum Level Cap will also be increased in the coming weeks so you’ll have even more reason to climb back to the top! 

[h2]NEW Features: Early Ascension and Wildcards[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/9d26c28caf1b5024f9a2d8bb3f6b5d94fe792ef0.png[/img]

Now that you have experienced two rounds of Celestial Ascension, we are excited to introduce an all-new feature called Early Ascension! This new process will allow you to attempt to Ascend a Celestial with an incomplete inventory! But beware…there is some risk involved. Unsuccessful attempts will result in some of the eggs being lost, however you will receive a “Wildcard” in return which can be applied to any inventory! So, whether you’re zapping an egg or powering up a Wubbox, Wildcards will be a valuable resource to have in your pocket. 

Thank you for joining us during our Anniversary Year Event - we couldn't have done it without you, and we are so grateful for your love and support. Happy Monstering!

notes.title: MindBoggle 2023
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=YDoyPB7QuAk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What's New
Boo’qwurm on Psychic Island[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/17991b0ee4c5c8f97697410d8bfeb8f5591283eb.png[/img]

Boo’qwurm hardly noticed how much time has passed since its debut on Seasonal Shanty since its head has been stuck in a book for almost a whole year! Now that MindBoggle has kicked off, this puzzle-loving brainiac has made its way to Psychic Island to share its love for reading and brain teasers! Although excited to join in on the festivities, you may notice Boo’qwurm missing out on a party here or there - that’s because it needs to finish just one…more…chapter! 

[h3]Dipsters on Psychic Island[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/6cbca4c717a0ca6227a1df394a98a9d8d3644dc2.png[/img]

It appears as though the rumors have been true all along! Cruv’laapht, the Psychic Island Titan, is proud to welcome the Dipster family to its home!

[h3]NEW Monster: Rare Bisonorus[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/6e27ef41f555a8dd14230a8b9bfaf517918dd070.png[/img]

The colorful new Rare Fire Monster is ridiculously strong and has been described as “virtually indestructible.” That may be attributed to its substantially larger and larger-than-life antlers of the Emperor residing on its head. These adjustments from its Common counterpart can be attributed to evolution throughout several generations to create a strong, almost-perfect specimen. The best part about this generational progression? The bond the Rare Fire Monster has solidified with its dome-dwelling companion, truly encompassing the idea of family. 

[h3]NEW Monster: Rare Creepuscule[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/4e54f93b51e57101a73bc9c24fedba064f1880e2.png[/img]

This newly discovered Rare Wublin has certainly upped its wig game! Donning an intricate red yarn hairpiece, this Monster is excited to show off such a beautiful contrast to its green complexion. Some have said that from afar, this Rare Wublin resembles some sort of tropical fruit - that is, until you see its teeth. You may quickly change your mind once you lay your eyes upon those rows of chompers…

[h3]NEW: MindBoggle Island Skin Available[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/4081916347a7cea3ca72266b731870035c47ba3f.png[/img]

You’ll want to pick up a book and learn something new when you get your first glimpse of the all-new MindBoggle Psychic Island Skin! Cruv’laapht, really put its mind to work when it manifested bookcases upon bookcases (upon bookcases!) to share its love for reading and researching with its beloved Monster inhabitants. You can purchase this Skin throughout the entirety of the MindBoggle Event and share your love of reading all year long!

[h3]NEW: MindBoggle Obstacle-Decorations Available[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/c859aadf81cc4c43e830c3d7bc9e82fb8c3ec0dc.png[/img]

The many eyes of Cruv’laapht have taken it upon themselves to catch up on some summer reading! The oversight? Its eyes are farsighted! They’ll need the help of magical magnifying glasses or snazzy spectacles to help them study their literary works and soak all that new-found information into their sporadically-spaced out brains! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/9b432585f637d14d8dba75619c35db9912309597.png[/img]

[h3]In This Update[/h3]

Boo’qwurm on Psychic Island
Dipsters on Psychic Island
NEW Monster: Rare Bisonorus
NEW Monster: Rare Creepuscule
NEW: MindBoggle Island Skin
NEW: MindBoggle Obstacle-Decorations
…and lots of exciting sales and promotions!

notes.title: Update 3.9.4
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=oGFj7r_ee9Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What's New

Celestial Ascension[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/842372031cc7119e7e4a153cfc1c6ca0891f0425.png[/img]

We’ve been listening to the stars for quite some time now, and this year we learned that the stars have their own stories to tell…
Introducing the astounding phenomenon of Celestial ASCENSION!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/23d38515d5db5bf28b0564ce46399653b8eefa14.png[/img]

Each month, one of the 12 CELESTIALS will unlock the ability to Ascend from its young form into an adult! You'll need to Zap the proper combination of eggs into its inventory, including hard-to-get Monsters like Seasonals and Rares... and you'll only have the duration of the month to do so. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/4987bcd5e2dc5d35e64133f6c102da41a1395748.png[/img]

Thankfully, you'll be able to use the new FLEX egg system to choose from an assortment of eligible Monsters to Zap. Then, when the inventory is complete, harness the power of KEYS to complete the Ascension! Because of their special connection to the genesis of the Monster World, Ascended Celestials can now generate Keys themselves! 

Let's kick it off with the first Celestial we met all those years ago... SCARATAR!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/b51b6229cd0fe7f53a947ace0bb7f3fc1406aff0.png[/img]



[h3]Earth Island Colossal Conundrum[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/a7eee2602f678292afd61cfb865b876cd3489a5a.png[/img]

The final Colossal Conundrum (for now, at least) has finally arrived on Earth Island! Does its appearance remind you of any other eye-opening reveals from Monsters past? You can begin awakening this final Conundrum right now! What will these eyes reveal?


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/9b432585f637d14d8dba75619c35db9912309597.png[/img]

notes.title: SummerSong 2023
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=wOCB0LV07ZY;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/bec0366a24810d235da1d08f3dd546802fe01d75.png[/img]

[h3]What's New
Hoola, Rare Hoola, and Epic Hoola Return![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/5acda1487093743bb2421a2b4c3a209a88c400dd.png[/img]

Hey Nana Hey! Hoola has returned to celebrate the 10th Monster World SummerSong Event! The notorious prankster surely has some tricks up its sleeve, but will likely be spending most of its time enjoying the party on Earth Island! There’s no doubt Hoola will be joined by its Rare and Epic counterparts during the Event, however you’ll need to keep your eyes peeled so you don’t miss out on their limited availability! Pay special attention to our social media platforms during SummerSong - you may be able to spot Epic Hoola in some unexpected places… BAH!



[h3]NEW Monster: Rare Incisaur[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/37c867a6feb87e8c63fc2e4b3aba29cf863d0bde.png[/img]

Rare Incisaur has a special talent of breaking down its Treats before devouring them by using venom instead of saliva! Fortunately, this potent toxin will not harm Monsters if it is accidentally ingested - reports from Monsters who have unintentionally eaten some of these venomous drippings have reported a rather mild side-effect of hiccups. Out of caution and care for its Monster friends, Rare Incisaur extends its neck frill outwards to warn others when it’s hungry (and therefore, salivating!). 



[h3]NEW Monster: Rare Tympa[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/e5505cf18e2267330b2f7325f88dbcb15ffd83c6.png[/img]

Wubbox has once again used its Spark of Life to unlock the evolutionary potential of another Rare Wublin! Rare Tympa’s appearance is a seemingly perfect match for the gloomy hues of Wublin Island and its constant Electrically stormy environment! That hairdo, though, is perfect for any type of weather, and any kind of mood!



[h3]NEW SummerSong Costumes Series[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/7f6c52d6569ef56f5972626fc85b66daf15bc666.png[/img]

This year we are excited to release a brand new collection of SummerSong costumes to join the roster of fun and sunny getups! Check out the nine new SummerSong apparel right now! You may be “shocked” by which Monsters are sporting a new fashion… We would remiss not to highlight the ELECTRIFYING In Da Club Costume for Wubbox - available for a special introductory discounted cost only for a limited time at the start of SummerSong!



[h3]NEW SummerSong Remix Album[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/b55c5cad31573ad34348adfd7776da8736ed6266.png[/img]

With DJ Epic missing from Club Box, the Monsters worked together to ensure the SummerSong 2023 Party would go on! We’re excited to announce our friends at Monstercat are releasing a SummerSong 2023 Party Album. Rock out to a Monstrous Amber Island Remix by Vintage & Morelli, a dreamy Mythical Island Remix by Cyazon, and a Wub-tastic Wublin Island Remix by Saxquatch. 
You can check out these three SummerSong Remixes RIGHT HERE


[h3]Seasonal Island Skin: SummerSong[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/5351e827ecc8382e06f5c7ae5dc588ab4c9783ce.png[/img]

Kick back and relax on the brilliant and serene beaches of the SummerSong Earth Island Skin! Your Monsters will undoubtedly want to lounge by tiki torchlight by night and build sandcastles by day during the dog-days of Summer. If you missed your chance to buy it during our impromptu Summer Getaway event earlier in Anniversary Year, the SummerSong Island Skin is now available for purchase so that Earth Island can rock the tropical decor all year round!



[h3]SummerSong Obstacle Decorations[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/cbdbef4556f8713a0dc30c22595aeaddae9147f8.png[/img]

As in SummerSong tradition of years past, Earth Island Obstacle-Decorations are back and ready for some summertime fun! Chill out beneath the husk umbrellas or on a chaise lounge after a long day of surfing. You may even want to take a dip in the tub or sit beneath a shaded parasol! Be forewarned - don’t drink from the coconut rocks - it seems their liquids may have dried up!

NEW Monster: Rare Tympa

Whiz-bang on Light Island[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/de6cab305acd436efee81b01b8106dc656f9a5f1.png[/img]

Whiz-bang was excited for its voice to be heard in a World of loud of boisterous Monsters and decided to transform into its own bright and colorful variant just in time for SkyPainting! This brightly hued and vibrant Monster has finally arrived on Light Island and is very eager to kick off the Island’s first-ever SkyPainting celebrations. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/b6bc85aea9aad93454dfa34540a25ed920a13c52.png[/img]

Although Rare Fluoress may appear to have skin that is drab and dreary, don’t mistake its lack of luster for a lack of personality! Obsessed with showtunes and committed to dentistry, this Rare Magical will have you snapping your fingers and clacking your teeth to its tonsorial tunes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/33577636e529bcc3b79167b227e8e9d479fe3c95.png[/img]

notes.title: Life-Formula 2023!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=MW_aoncU2LE;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]What's New

Monculus on Ethereal Island and Wublin Island[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/f3da5c6495e9289229210e74e361f70ea4307aaf.png[/img]

At last! The Spark of Life has awakened the long-awaited Monculus on Ethereal Island and Wublin Island! Its hauntingly beautiful refrain adds a whole new dimension to both Island songs that will undoubtedly take your breath away. Check out this ancient prototype on both Islands right now!

[h2]NEW Monster: Epic Whisp[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/d9dbd6dcf59abde5a3d0826937c860444103f242.png[/img]

Epic Whisp has made its mysterious and melancholic debut in the Monster World, straddling the line between macabre and lovely, and morose and bewitching… This Epic Ethereal may certainly be harboring a secret that only a few in the Monster World are privy to… It is said that the only way to uncover the secret is to be hypnotized by the Epic Whisp’s “potion eyes.” Will you be able to uncover the mystery of this clandestine Monster?


[h2]NEW Monster: Rare Blipsqueak[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/5443c58284c7d3c9c8027b1beccab82862c0b253.png[/img]

Rare Blipsqueak dons a mesmerizing gold-plated suit, really digging into its automata-roots. In fact, nothing about this Rare Wublin is biological! Even Rare Blipsqueak’s eyes are synthetic! Its retro-futuristic design exudes the illustrious history of the Kingdom of Mait-Land and brings it to life for all to see.


[h2]NEW Seasonal Island Skin: Life-Formula[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/c260a290a52147b50788ad16a26c4af9a25f3078.png[/img]

Rewind the clock and bear witness to the formation of one of the oldest Islands in the Monster World! This Island Skin is a tribute to the early days of the pocket dimension as the experimental sandbox was molded by its eccentric Colossal caretaker into a full-blown Island. You may notice through the Blubberite sculptures and blueprinted landmarks that this Seasonal Skin is truly special, giving us a rare glimpse into the Life-Formula creative process that was started by the Colossals. You can purchase this Island Skin and celebrate the momentous occasion all year round!


[h2]NEW Life-Formula Obstacle Decorations[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/ec51506f139becba4baaf5400444b867b8250a00.png[/img]

The Life-Formula obstacle-decorations are an ode to the early drafts of Monsters designed by the Colossals. Regrettably, none of these Monster designs ever came to fruition, however they have now been solidified as a testament to the ingenuity of their creators. The trees are truly special and were “mocked up” using plasmic Krystillium suspended in place by electricity, leaving us with their mesmerizing and almost hypnotizing design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/2393a45c6c2b3b0ff354bcb7cbb284c476941768.png[/img]

We’ve been anxiously waiting a whole year for Carillong to make its home Island debut, and it sure did not disappoint! The Monsters of Magical Sanctum welcomed Carillong with open arms and were thrilled when the magic of the Monster’s Chimekeeper decorated the Enchantler Titan in the spirit of Crescendo Moon! Carillong really “chimes” in and adds a certain feeling of tranquility and eloquence to the Magical Sanctum song, making all the Monsters feel inspired for all of the exciting things coming in the year ahead!
It’s worth noting that Carillong is not currently teleportable to Seasonal Shanty at Level 15, but it won’t be that way forever! The Monster-Handlers have encountered some conflicts in interdimensional magic but are confident that they will be able to correct this in a future update!

[h3]NEW Monster: Rare Xyster[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/462eb59fe934c4bfb5bd7aed6a7cbc3ec92e0aee.png[/img]

Lacking the elongate antlers of the Common Xyster, this Rare Magical nevertheless has adapted itself to collect the thoughts of nearby beings. That said, it sets its sights on a much bigger target than mere Monsters - it can listen in on the ruminations of Enchantler itself! The Rare Xyster is able to accomplish this via various villi covering its body that maximize surface contact as it tunnels through the pores of the Titan.
 
[h3]NEW: Crescendo Moon Seasonal Obstacle-Decorations[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/c4e2fabbc0a978f5a297cb63a901f2fc72fa3d26.png[/img]

Magical Sanctum has been beautifully decorated with brand new Obstacle-Decorations to celebrate the festivities that Crescendo Moon has to offer! Vases containing groves of lucky bamboo (which isn’t actually bamboo, but a species called Mon-drake-aena!) and gilded pots containing resplendent red fortune fruit help to transform Magical Sanctum into the ultimate Crescendo Moon celebration!

[h3]NEW: Crescendo Moon Seasonal Island Skin[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/db9093e9c19c7029bd112b9adf1b852a8efbbb2f.png[/img]

The next of our Seasonal Island Skins is available - Crescendo Moon Skin for Magical Sanctum! This time of year is marked by a period of efflorescence - winter cherries and peonies miraculously take root on the normally fallow landscape. As paper lanterns sway overhead and the glow of the Titan's antlers is reflected in the beautiful cloisonné pin, you can't help but feel that this year is going to be YOUR year!

[h3]NEW: Krystillium Castles on Ethereal Island and Magical Sanctum[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/acf5cf8827e41015bf531ff43b173d478723321d.png[/img]

For the first time ever, Islands in the Pocket Dimension are getting Crystalline Castles! These structures are made from the especially rare mineral, “Krystillium,” which served as the prototype template for Pyrozite in the main dimension! You may notice the Castles have subtle differences in appearance on each Island, adding some “homey” touches of the Enchanter’s miniature antlers on Magical Sanctum, and otherworldly landscape elements from Ethereal Island. Your Monsters sure will be cozy in their new homes!

[h1]
“Colossal Conundra" FAQ[/h1]

[b]Q: How do Colossal Conundra work?[/b]
A: Log in every day to collect a puzzle piece of a Colossal Conundrum, and receive a special reward too! Once all of the pieces of a Conundrum have been assembled, an eye-opening surprise awaits... the gigantic being rumbles to life, a special Structure called the Coloss-Eye manifests, and the sonorous voice of the Colossal is heard for the first time in forever!

[b]Q: How do I claim rewards from the Colossal Conundra?[/b]
A: Puzzle pieces are automatically added to a Conundrum every day! If you are collecting a Currency reward, it will automatically be credited to your account. If you are collecting a Monster/Costume reward, it will be available for free in the corresponding submenu of the Market.

[b]Q: How do I get the Coloss-Eye?[/b]
A: The Coloss-Eye is a special Structure that is rewarded to a player when all of the pieces of a Colossal Conundrum have been assembled. It will be available for free in the Structures submenu of the Market to place on its corresponding Island.

[b]Q: What happens if I don’t log in every day?[/b]
A: Don’t fret! Unlike the regular Daily Login Bonus, there is no ‘streak’ to lose with Colossal Conundra. Every new day that you log in to My Singing Monsters, you will receive a new puzzle piece and reward. A new piece becomes available each day at 10 AM EST.

[b]Q: Can I speed up a Colossal Conundrum or make up for lost days?[/b]
A: Not in Version 3.8, but the Monster-Handlers are working on a system to use Diamonds to make up for a few lost days in a future update!

[b]Q: Can I view a Colossal Conundrum outside of collecting its daily rewards?[/b]
A: Not in Version 3.8, but the Monster-Handlers are working on adding this feature in a future update!


[h1]“Seasonal Island Skins” FAQ[/h1]

[b]Q: How do I activate the Seasonal Island Skin on Cold Island?[/b]
A: You can activate a Seasonal Island Skin on Cold Island by going to its Info menu () and selecting the Seasonal tab (). From there, simply tap on the ‘Activate (trial)’ button to apply the Festival of Yay Seasonal Island Skin! This system replaces the automatic reskin that took place in versions earlier than 3.8.

[b]Q: What do Seasonal Island Skins do?[/b]
A: In addition to redecorating an island in the style of its Seasonal Event, helpful Boosts are applied to the island as well! Just like the Titan-themed Island Skins, these Boosts will be applied even if the Seasonal Island Skin is deactivated.

[b]Q: How do I buy Seasonal Island Skins?[/b]
A: You can buy a Seasonal Island Skin by tapping on the Buy button under the portrait in the Seasonal tab. You can choose to spend your Diamonds, or buy a specially-priced Island Skin pack that gives you the Seasonal Island Skin AND 50 bonus Diamonds!

[b]Q: When can I get Seasonal Island Skins?[/b]
A: Seasonal Island Skins are only available for the duration of their associated Seasonal Event. Make sure to buy it during the Event if you are interested in keeping it year-round!

[b]Q: What if I don’t want to buy a Seasonal Island Skin?[/b]
A: No problem! You will still have access to the free trial of the Seasonal Island Skin for the duration of its Seasonal Event.

[b]Q: Once I activate an Island Skin, will my Island permanently be decorated in that way?
[/b]
A: Once you have purchased any Island Skin, you will have the ability to activate and deactivate it to toggle it on or off whenever you like!

notes.content:
[h1]What’s New[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/471fcb499cecc423e127ccbedc40f1433e234e89.png[/img]
[h2]New Island: Magical Sanctum![/h2]
Few are brave enough to explore the dark nooks and crannies of the pocket dimension… but if you are, there you’ll find the majestic [b]Magical Sanctum[/b]. There are so many new incredibly magical sights and sounds to experience, right now!
[h2]New Magical Monsters![/h2]
Of course, the sacred Magical Sanctum is home to Monsters like never seen before. Say hello to your new favorite Monsters: [b]Frondley[/b], [b]Knucklehead[/b], [b]Xyster[/b], [b]Déjà-Jin[/b], and [b]Larvaluss[/b] (making their debut soon after this update)! More Monsters to come, stay tuned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/a10cb1de0f2005ec1fa0e33896a15a49c4d3294c.png[/img]

[*][b]StarShop on Shugabush and Ethereal Islands[/b]: The StarShop is coming to Shugabush and Ethereal Islands complete with beautiful new custom Star Rocks![/list]

[*][b]Friendly Matches[/b]: Looking for even more ways to compete? Now you can challenge your friends to playful sing-offs that are all about fun in Friendly Matches, accessible in the new Rank Menu!
[*][b]Jukebox[/b]: The Mess Hall structure on the Colossingum has been upgraded with a Jukebox! As you complete Quests and boost your Colossingum Level, you’ll unlock awesome tunes to enjoy on your island.

notes.title: My Singing Monsters - Coming To Steam!
notes.content:
My Singing Monsters is an award winning world-building game where you collect and raise peculiar Monsters that bring unique tunes! Breed and feed hundreds of Monsters to build an eerie ensemble of musicians in a variety of exciting environments in high resolution right on your desktop. Fun design options and amazing decorations let you make your world look just as you want.

Add to your Wishlist now so you do not miss out on this monstrously addictive game!

[h1]Features[/h1]
[h2]Monster Breeding[/h2]
Monsters can be combined and bred to create incredible and rare Monsters that bring new music to your world. The rarest Monsters are created through advanced breeding.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/c3f496abeca8743c1f1b19470df623ecbcd0c3e0.png[/img]
[h2]Decorating & Design[/h2]
Customize and improve your Monster world with an incredible assortment of creative decorations, offering every player something unique to enjoy. Monsters absolutely love having their Islands decorated!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/39210a900106d0b97a566705edd91317bcab087d.png[/img]
[h2]Unique Islands[/h2]
The Monster world consists of many different Islands where Monsters live, grow, and sing. Each Island offers a different type of environment for your Monsters to inhabit; see how their songs change with their surroundings.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/d13410947a44aec1fd7851382b8367a6bc1a2582.png[/img]
[h2]Fun Tunes[/h2]
Every Monster offers a different catchy tune to enjoy which changes to match their Island surroundings. Each player has their own favorite combination of Monsters and Islands to make their favorite tunes!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/11a5f0473a561cf327fee6b4188fa59e2779d54f.png[/img]
[h2]High-Resolution Artwork[/h2]
For the first time ever, experience the Monster World and all the beautiful artwork it has to offer in full high-definition. Enjoy every eerie & intricate Monster detail like never before!


[h1]Meet (some of) The Monsters![/h1]
[h3]Mammott[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/d1491879e031f2a344a6a94e70958c10e0cf6597.png[/img]
[i][b]Mammotts’[/b] luxurious fur ensures that these Cold elementals are never chilly. 
Tangles, however, are an ongoing issue.[/i]

[h3]Ghazt[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/33258770c147899e8f497e27ae964447a86de3c5.png[/img]
[i]The extraordinary [b]Ghazt[/b] only manifests itself when conditions are absolutely perfect. 
Imbued with the Ethereal power of Plasma, its sleek frame and ability to become intangible are ideal for slipping in and out of places unnoticed.[/i]

[h3]Congle[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39941884/7cf35fe5ebfdfb90f63f7f23a94d8ac4a5884dcd.png[/img]
[i]So that's what happens to the shells when Monsters hatch! [b]Congles[/b] are great recyclers, and use a lot of drums. Eggshells can only stand so much pounding, after all.[/i]

[b]Every Monster has its own story and song; collect them all to bring your Monster World to life![/b]

[h2]FAQ[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]How many Monsters can I collect?[/b]
There are 250 Monsters to collect! Monsters are added regularly, so there’s always more to collect.

[*][b]How many Islands are there for me to discover and explore?[/b]
There are over a dozen unique Islands to decorate and populate, each offering a different landscape and more ways to have fun.

[*][b]Can I carry over my Mobile game progress?[/b]
My Singing Monsters on PC is a standalone experience; progress made on mobile does not carry over to the Steam version. Use your Monster expertise to rediscover your favorites and create your dream Islands!

[*][b]Can I play with friends?[/b]
You can play with friends, while also earning extra rewards! Visit the Tribal Island to team up in Tribes, coming together to feed Monsters and level up for bonus prizes.

[*][b]Will there be new content?[/b]
My Singing Monsters (PC) will be up-to-date with the My Singing Monsters (iOS/Android/Amazon) version 3.0.1 at launch, with updates to follow.

[*][b]What about Seasonal events?[/b]
My Singing Monsters offers regular seasonal events and celebrations! The Festival of Yay in winter, Eggs-Travaganza around Easter - whatever your favorite human holiday is, the Monsters have a Monsterific equivalent. Keep playing year-round for more exciting seasonal events.

[/list]

Add My Singing Monsters to your Wishlist and prepare to discover and collect [b]hundreds[/b] of Monsters! Follow us for even more exciting news, updates, and events.
